meta.name: SkillIssue — Neon Glass (VST3 UI)
meta.description: Plugin UI derived from the dazz_mechanicjob / MechOS phone style: iOS-dark surfaces on a dotted night background, heavy grotesk titles, lime accent only where something acts. Rendered in JUCE (no CSS), so every effect is a 2D vector draw.
source_references: MechOS v2 phone apps (State, Bank, Recents)

secondary.role: wells: knob tracks, segmented controls, waveform bed

accent.role: value arcs, active toggles, playhead, CTA

neutral.usage: #f4f5f6 values and titles, #8e8e93 labels, #636366 hints, #3a3a3c hairlines, darkest = window background

color.contrast_strategy: light text on layered darks; lime is the only saturated colour on screen

font_families.heading: Segoe UI Black / SF Pro Display Heavy (system)

typography.font_style_notes: UI strings are English and short (Decay, Pre-Delay, Hi Cut)

layout.grid_system: header bar + card grid; floating tab bar for pages (Reverb: MAIN / TEMPO / EQ, Riser: SOURCE / SHAPE / FX)

motion.philosophy: values glide (30 Hz repaint), toggles snap

components.knob: ring knob: dark well, 270° track, lime value arc with soft glow, centre value text, label below
components.toggle: rounded-square button; on = lime fill + dark text, off = elevated grey
components.combo: dark pill with chevron, popup in card colour
components.readout_table: grouped list rows like iOS Settings (tempo table)

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: tinted glass over a night garage

canvas_drawings.description: Reverb: live decay envelope + animated RT60 curve. Riser: rendered waveform with lime gradient fill, shape curve overlay and playhead

visual_effects.composite_notes: Glow = accent drawn 3x with growing stroke and falling alpha (no blur filter, cheap in software renderer).
